val: Din gendannelsessætning (hvis du har gemt den) er stadig kilden til sandheden. Hvis du har en iCloud-tegnebog-sikkerhedskopi, skal du gendanne den, når du fortsætter. Aperture opfinder ikke en vellykket gendannelse - kun du kan gendanne fra phrase eller backup.

key: Your recovery phrase is saved and your keys are secured on this device.
en: Your recovery phrase is saved and your keys are secured on this device.
val: Din gendannelsessætning er gemt, og dine nøgler er sikret på denne enhed.

key: Your recovery phrase is saved. You can find your wallet on the main screen.
en: Your recovery phrase is saved. You can find your wallet on the main screen.
val: Din gendannelsessætning er gemt. Du finder din tegnebog på startskærmen.

key: Your recovery phrase is stored as AES-GCM ciphertext in this app’s local database. The encryption key is also kept on this iPhone (not in iCloud Keychain). Anyone with an unlocked phone and access to the app can export it after passcode/Face ID. The phrase never leaves this device on its own.
en: Your recovery phrase is stored as AES-GCM ciphertext in this app’s local database. The encryption key is also kept on this iPhone (not in iCloud Keychain). Anyone with an unlocked phone and access to the app can export it after passcode/Face ID. The phrase never leaves this device on its own.
val: Din gendannelsessætning gemmes som AES-GCM chiffertekst i denne app's lokale database. Krypteringsnøglen opbevares også på denne iPhone (ikke i iCloud nøglering). Alle med en ulåst telefon og adgang til appen kan eksportere den efter adgangskode/Face ID. Sætningen forlader aldrig denne enhed alene.

key: Your recovery phrase is stored encrypted in the local database on this iPhone (AES-GCM 256-bit). Tap “View recovery phrase” anytime — the phrase never leaves this device.
en: Your recovery phrase is stored encrypted in the local database on this iPhone (AES-GCM 256-bit). Tap “View recovery phrase” anytime — the phrase never leaves this device.
val: Din gendannelsessætning er gemt krypteret i den lokale database på denne iPhone (AES-GCM 256-bit). Tryk på "Se gendannelsessætning" når som helst - sætningen forlader aldrig denne enhed.

key: Your recovery phrase is the only way back.
en: Your recovery phrase is the only way back.
val: Din gendannelsessætning er den eneste vej tilbage.

key: Your recovery phrase is the only way to restore your wallet.
en: Your recovery phrase is the only way to restore your wallet.
val: Gendannelsesfrasen er den eneste måde at gendanne din wallet på.

key: Your recovery phrase restores every account on every network. Treat it like the keys to a vault.
en: Your recovery phrase restores every account on every network. Treat it like the keys to a vault.
val: Din gendannelsessætning gendanner enhver konto på ethvert netværk. Behandl den som nøglerne til et pengeskab.

key: Your recovery phrase stays yours. You can import this wallet again with it — there is no server, and removing it here loses nothing you've written down.
en: Your recovery phrase stays yours. You can import this wallet again with it — there is no server, and removing it here loses nothing you've written down.
val: Din gendannelsessætning forbliver din. Du kan importere denne tegnebog igen med den — der er ingen server, og at fjerne den her mister intet, du har skrevet ned.

key: Your recovery phrase stays yours. You can import this wallet again with it — there is no server, and removing it here loses nothing you’ve written down.
en: Your recovery phrase stays yours. You can import this wallet again with it — there is no server, and removing it here loses nothing you’ve written down.
val: Din gendannelsessætning forbliver din. Du kan importere denne tegnebog igen med den — der er ingen server, og at fjerne den her mister intet, du har skrevet ned.

key: Your recovery phrase was encrypted on your device with a password you chose. Only that encrypted copy lives in your private iCloud — Apple and Aperture can never read it.
en: Your recovery phrase was encrypted on your device with a password you chose. Only that encrypted copy lives in your private iCloud — Apple and Aperture can never read it.
val: Din gendannelsessætning blev krypteret på din enhed med en adgangskode, du valgte. Kun den krypterede kopi ligger i dit private iCloud — Apple og Aperture kan aldrig læse den.

key: Your recovery phrase was verified and your keys are now secured on this device.
en: Your recovery phrase was verified and your keys are now secured on this device.
val: Din gendannelsesfrase er bekræftet, og dine nøgler er nu beskyttet på denne enhed.

key: Your recovery phrase will be replaced.
en: Your recovery phrase will be replaced.

key: Your wallet history, contacts, cached balances, and portfolio snapshots.
en: Your wallet history, contacts, cached balances, and portfolio snapshots.
val: Din tegnebogshistorik, kontakter, cachelagrede saldi og porteføljeøjebliksbilleder.

key: Your wallet is on this iPhone only. If your iPhone is lost, broken, or wiped, your wallet — and everything in it — is gone. The recovery phrase is the only way back.
en: Your wallet is on this iPhone only. If your iPhone is lost, broken, or wiped, your wallet — and everything in it — is gone. The recovery phrase is the only way back.
val: Din tegnebog findes kun på denne iPhone. Hvis din iPhone bliver væk, går i stykker eller slettes, er tegnebogen — og alt i den — væk. Gendannelsessætningen er den eneste vej tilbage.

key: Your wallet is ready. Back up your recovery phrase so you can restore it later if you lose this device.
en: Your wallet is ready. Back up your recovery phrase so you can restore it later if you lose this device.
val: Din tegnebog er klar. Sikkerhedskopier din gendannelsessætning, så du kan gendanne den senere, hvis du mister denne enhed.

key: Your wallet is ready. Balances and activity will appear as networks refresh.
en: Your wallet is ready. Balances and activity will appear as networks refresh.
val: Din tegnebog er klar. Saldi og aktivitet vises, når netværk opdateres.

key: Your wallet was created successfully and is ready to use.
en: Your wallet was created successfully and is ready to use.
val: Din tegnebog blev oprettet og er klar til brug.

key: Your wallet was imported successfully and is ready to use.
en: Your wallet was imported successfully and is ready to use.
val: Din tegnebog blev importeret og er klar til brug.

key: Your written phrase is the only copy. Aperture has no copy of it — keep it safe.
en: Your written phrase is the only copy. Aperture has no copy of it — keep it safe.
val: Din nedskrevne sætning er den eneste kopi. Aperture har ingen kopi af den — opbevar den sikkert.

key: Your passcode unlocks Aperture and protects this iPhone's copy of your wallets.
en: Your passcode unlocks Aperture and protects this iPhone's copy of your wallets.
val: Din adgangskode låser Aperture op og beskytter denne iPhones kopi af dine tegnebøger.

key: Your passcode unlocks Aperture. %@ is a faster shortcut to the same lock — you can always fall back to passcode.
en: Your passcode unlocks Aperture. %@ is a faster shortcut to the same lock — you can always fall back to passcode.
val: Din adgangskode låser Aperture op. %@ er en hurtigere genvej til den samme lås - du kan altid falde tilbage til adgangskoden.

key: Without a passcode, your wallet is only protected by your iPhone's lock screen. Turn on a passcode to require authentication every time you open Aperture — and to use %@.
en: Without a passcode, your wallet is only protected by your iPhone's lock screen. Turn on a passcode to require authentication every time you open Aperture — and to use %@.
val: Uden en adgangskode er din tegnebog kun beskyttet af din iPhones låseskærm. Slå en adgangskode til for at kræve godkendelse, hver gang du åbner Aperture - og for at bruge %@.

key: Require %@ before each of these actions. If it fails, you can fall back to your passcode.
en: Require %@ before each of these actions. If it fails, you can fall back to your passcode.
val: Kræv %@ før hver af disse handlinger. Hvis det mislykkes, kan du falde tilbage til din adgangskode.
